description: Vaults ranked by YIELD over 7d to 365d. basis=realised (default): share-price growth; realised.periodReturn over the days actually covered (realised.window: requestedDays, elapsedDays, nExpected/nObserved, lastPointAt), realised.rate that change annualised SIMPLY (not compounded, not a realised year), realised.apyEquivalent the compounded equivalent; in the vault’s own asset, never assumed equal to dollars. basis=advertised: the simple mean of the daily quotes over the same days with low/high and the latest quote kept apart; quoteSource says whose rate (venue_direct, aggregator_calculated, third_party_observed, unknown) and its rateKind. A variable rate, not a guarantee. basis=gap: historical quoted rate vs share-price growth in ONE convention (an APY quote against the APY equivalent): `rows` under the quote, `upside` over it, ranked from 1 on its own (boardRank on the whole board). comparison.status comparable | not_comparable (why) | source_conflict (our copy and the venue’s history a median 1 pt or more apart; no verdict); deliveryRatio only where meaningful (not against a quote of 0.5% or less, not for a falling share price); 0.5–1.5× is a wide band. eligibility splits sharePriceReturn, venueQuote, rewardsKnown, totalReturn, comparablePair: a sound share price with a refused quote is on the realised board with the reason in advertisedRefused (population.realisedOnlyBy); uncovered windows are counted in coverage.refused, other refusals in population.excluded, never ranked. Filters: asset, chain, minTvl, maxBand (unbanded never passes), rewards (verified-none | exclude-known, the same as excludeIncentives | unknown-only; rewardCounts), q. rankChange is PLACES against the board of rankFromDay. FREE: 10 rows; 50 with statistics need a plan (`capability`). Depositors’ own results: `depositors`.

asset.description: Asset class of the vault’s underlying.

chain.description: One network, e.g. ethereum or base.

excludeIncentives.description: Drop vaults KNOWN to pay 5% or more of their quoted pay as reward tokens; vaults whose reward share is not read are KEPT (the same as rewards=exclude-known).

maxBand.description: FINAL-band ceiling: keep vaults whose final band (the worst of the base model, the stored report’s published band and the credit-chain floor) is this or safer; a vault with no band or a withheld one never passes. `bandFilter` says what it read and how many rows rest on the base model alone.

minTvl.description: Minimum capital in dollars; the floor is one million.

noKnownHighSevere.description: Keep only vaults with no high or severe finding anywhere we read AND liquidity and controller both read. Not a statement that a vault is safe.

q.description: Search: a vault name, venue or curator, slug, or an address (0x… or Solana base58) whole or in part; case-insensitive, every word must match. Searches the whole board with a plan; free, only the ten free rows.

rewards.description: verified-none: only vaults whose reward share was read and is under 5%; exclude-known: drop the known incentivised, keep the unknown; unknown-only: only the unread. Counts in rewardCounts.

window.description: Default 30d. Advertised history is shorter than 180d: those boards say so in coverage.

name: yield_leaderboard

bandFilter.description: What maxBand reads (the final band) and, over the matched rows, how many rest on a report or credit reading, the base model alone or a withheld band. Each row’s `risk` (null on older readings) carries finalBand, baseModelBand, highestFinding, requiredUnread, depositStatus, `badges` (each {text, tone, asOf, source}: a severe liquidity finding, the venue’s withdrawable figure where it is under $1,000 or 1% of capital with its time, a simulation in which no tested size passed with its block, deposits closed or unknown, concentration) and `exitEvidence` (venue-reported, simulated and settled exits as separate statements, never one figure; unknown where none is held), free on every row. A simulation is an eth_call at one block and never a statement that a vault cannot be left.

capability.description: The capability that opens the rest, where something is withheld.

coverage.description: How many vaults have a figure over this window, the refusals by reason, and whether the window outruns the advertised history.

meta.description: How current this answer is and what it was read from: `freshness` and the ages behind it. Present on every answer from this server, whatever the tool.

population.description: Open vaults of $1M or more, how many are comparable, and the rest by the realised job’s reason.

rows.description: Ranked rows: realised {rate (simple annualised), periodReturn, apyEquivalent, days, from, to, window} with realisedSource, advertised {mean, low, high, now, nowDay, rateKind, claim (whose rate, from quoteSource), days, sources[{source, days, says}]} (where each day of the quote came from), advertisedWhy {label, says} where no quote stands (e.g. "no claim published", "venue claim out of date", "claim record too short"), quoteSource, comparison, sourceConflict, eligibility, rewards, deliveryRatio, gapPoints (same convention), rank, rankChange, tvlUsd, assetClass, chain, curator (with curatorSlug and curatorIcon, the picture the venue publishes; null where none), riskBand (base model), risk (see bandFilter), impaired, spark; statistics (with whyNull: a reason key and words for every null statistic) null without a plan.

upside.description: basis=gap: the share price over the quote, widest first, ranked from 1 on its own (boardRank the place on the whole board); null on the other boards.

warnings.description: Anything the server wants a caller to know about THIS answer before acting on it. Empty is the normal case and is not a guarantee.

withheld.description: Rows of the fifty not in this answer because the plan does not carry them.

title: Yield leaderboard
